what: Documents that resolve to a model ONLY through a surface the original text continues as a version - `fable 5` matched inside `fable 5.1`. Detected by re-locating each hit in the ORIGINAL text, which is not always possible: a surface can match only in normalised space, and those are counted apart.
method_limit: `normalize_with_boundaries` returns no offsets back to the source, so a surface matching only in normalised space cannot be re-located and is SKIPPED rather than judged. That limit is the finding: the guard cannot be written inside resolve() without those offsets.
